incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: billing.metering.token_count drift detected. High variance vs baseline, delayed usage events for us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Auto-pager -> @oncall-sre

oncall-sre: on it. digging into dashboards now. which teams should I pull in?

jamie: @oncall-sre add @billing-eng and @sophia — looks like emitter retries spiked around 14:02 UTC.

sophia: I see the same on the emitter queue: consumer lag jumped to ~45k msgs. possible downstream DB throttling.

matt: uploading quick query snapshot: `SELECT region, count(*) FROM usage_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY 1;` result shows eu-west-1 ~30% lower than expected.

li: stack traces show `EMITTER_RETRY` logged for a subset of jobs, redis backpressure at 14:01. linking logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/emitter/14-01

billing-eng: confirmed a handful of customers got overage flags routed at 14:10 — those flags rely on near-real-time counts. looks like delayed events caused false positives.

cs-lead: do we have scope of customer impact? which accounts flagged? need to triage potential support tickets.

jamie: short list: acct-231, acct-482, acct-991 — all low-volume customers but still triggered alerts. I'll DM the list to @cs-lead.

sophia: mitigation proposal: flip emitter to fallback pipeline (`emit-v2-fallback`) that bypasses the slow consumer and reduces retries. can do a controlled flip on the feature flag.

oncall-sre: how fast can we flip and what's the rollback?

sophia: flip is `PATCH /api/flags/emitter/fallback {"value": true}` — should take effect within 10s. rollback is same call set false.

matt: recommend suppressing overage notifications during mitigation to avoid noisy customer emails: `billing.overage.notify=false`. need signoff from billing-eng + cs.

billing-eng: approve suppressing notifications for 30m while we mitigate and backfill. we'll also record exact accounts to reconcile.

cs-lead: approve temporary suppression, but we must notify any customers impacted after backfill with clear timeline and apology.

oncall-sre: executing mitigation now: flipping emitter fallback and pausing notifications. will post updates in 1m.

incident-bot: ACTION: runbook step started: `emitter -> fallback` by oncall-sre at 4912345690

oncall-sre: flipped `emitter.fallback=true` and set `billing.overage.notify=false`. queue backlog is draining, retries down to ~2k.

sophia: good signal: consumer lag trending down, redis p99 latency back to normal.

jamie: starting backfill process for 14:00-14:20 window to re-emit missing usage events. ETA ~20m.

billing-eng: after backfill we'll re-calc and remove false overage flags; creating ticket to reverse any billing actions.

cs-lead: will draft customer comms template once we have final impacted list. 

oncall-sre: setting incident priority P1 -> meter drift. assigning postmortem owner: @matt.

incident-bot: UPDATE: mitigation succeeded so far, backlog reduced. Please continue monitoring for 60m.

matt: noted. I'll own the postmortem and include timeline, root cause (redis backpressure + consumer throttling), and remediation plan (circuit-breaker on emitter retries, alert thresholds).

li: saving logs and traces to the incident folder: https://incidents.redwood/4912345678

cs-lead: thanks all — customer comms once backfill is confirmed. :thumbsup:
